item.title: Was FunnyMike arrested? Viral rumor accuses YouTuber of new murder charge as truth finally comes out
item.description: A viral post falsely claimed YouTuber FunnyMike was arrested for murder in 2026. The claim came from a parody account and had no police or media support. FunnyMike is free and active online. His only real murder charge was in 2016, and the case was suspended in 2017 due to lack of evidence.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Twitch streamer PlaqueBoyMax opens up about lust addiction and quitting weed
item.description: Popular streamer PlaqueBoyMax has bravely revealed his struggles with lust addiction and a desire to quit marijuana use. He shared his personal journey towards self-improvement with his online audience, aiming to inspire others facing similar challenges. This candid confession has resonated widely, highlighting the human side of online personalities and sparking conversations about mental health.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Man bought 240 Land Rover Defenders worth £8 million on borrowed money and made insane returns
item.description: When Land Rover ended Defender production, Twisted Automotive founder Charles Fawcett made a high-risk bet, buying 240 new vehicles on borrowed money. Rather than flip them, he rebuilt each as a bespoke luxury restomod. As demand surged, prices soared into six figures, turning the gamble into a project worth more than £50 million and reshaping the company’s future.

item.title: Drunk passenger who jumped 100 feet off cruise ship recounts ‘cement-like’ impact in shark-infested waters
item.description: Nick Naydev, 27, survived a 100-foot jump from the Symphony of the Seas while docked in the Bahamas, despite severe risk and alcohol influence. The stunt, filmed by friends, sparked outrage and a permanent Royal Caribbean ban. Naydev later described the painful impact and dangerous waters, warning others against reckless behavior and the thin line between thrill-seeking and fatal risk.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: Popular rapper and Twitch streamer Snoop Dogg’s daughter Cori announces heartbreaking loss of newborn daughter
item.description: Snoop Dogg's daughter, Cori Broadus, has announced the tragic passing of her daughter, Codi, who was born three months premature. Codi spent most of her short life in the NICU. Despite recent moments of joy after returning home, the family is devastated by the loss, receiving widespread condolences and support.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Adin Ross Calls For Proof: Streamer urges transparency in TeamWater; MrBeast yet to respond
item.description: Adin Ross questioned the transparency of MrBeast’s TeamWater initiative during a January 30 livestream, saying high-profile charity projects need visible proof and regular updates. While denying he was calling the project a scam, Ross argued that silence invites skepticism. He compared the situation to Kai Cenat’s Africa school project, stressing that public accountability helps prevent backlash.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: Tectone Loses Civil Court Case Filed by Ex-Girlfriend Pinkchyu in Texas
item.description: Streamer Tectone has lost a civil protective order case filed by his ex-girlfriend Pinkchyu. A Texas court granted Pinkchyu a 10-year protective order against Tectone. The order restricts contact and requires Tectone to maintain distance. This civil ruling does not involve criminal charges. Tectone publicly acknowledged the outcome, noting the difference in civil proceedings.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Dismissed as piles: Fit 31-year-old warns against ‘silent’ cancer symptoms after ‘big, ominous’ tumour found
item.description: Chris Kirt, a 31-year-old father diagnosed with stage two bowel cancer, shares his journey from dismissing early, subtle symptoms to undergoing surgery and achieving remission. Highlighting night sweats, fatigue, and changes in bowel habits, he now raises awareness of bowel cancer’s “silent” signs, especially in younger adults, encouraging vigilance, early detection, and self-advocacy in medical care.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: Prince Andrew’s ex-wife Sarah Ferguson told Epstein ‘just marry me’ after he was released from jail
item.description: Newly released emails reveal Sarah Ferguson maintained contact with Jeffrey Epstein for years after his 2008 conviction for soliciting a minor. The correspondence, extending into at least 2011, shows Ferguson offering VIP access to royal properties and expressing affectionate sentiments towards Epstein, despite his criminal record and public scrutiny.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan unveils Dh500m Umm Suqeim Beach makeover
item.description: Dubai is investing Dh500 million to transform Umm Suqeim 1 Beach into a world-class, sustainable urban destination. Approved by H.H. Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the project aims to boost public beach length by 400% and offer 24/7 enjoyment with advanced facilities, enhancing quality of life and tourism.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: If you bought just $1 of Bitcoin when it launched 17 years ago, how rich would you be today?
item.description: Bitcoin’s early years read like financial folklore. Launched in 2009 as a fringe experiment, it was dismissed, ignored, or casually spent. Yet tiny sums once worth dollars would today equal millions or billions. From lost hard drives to legendary pizza purchases, Bitcoin’s history is defined less by complexity than by scale, and how easily it was missed.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk
